entry_points.text: Boot seeds randomness under guest encryption, resolves SNP tables and registers platform devices.
Paging derives lower bases via the direct map; global flush uses broadcast when present else IPIs; direct-map changes delegate to init.
Fault lookup finds records by aligned address under read protection; page-state helper normalizes alignment and delegates chunks.

exports.text: CC queries dispatch by vendor state; transforms apply or strip the encryption mask by mode, else identity.
IO mapping validates and reserves caching mode via a caller-tracked path with encrypted variant; unmapping releases validated areas.
Inspection resolves addresses to entries with level and attributes; constructors and setters install upper levels, folding without five-level.
Cache helpers retune ranges; SNP shared/private and encrypted helpers update paging plus host state, no-ops without SNP.
Randomness returns longs with bounded retries gated on CPU enablement; MMIO probes install per-range traps, failing on overlap or missing slots.
SEV enrolls GHCB frames, provisions per-CPU areas and messaging descriptors, and serves early table memory; SVSM validates ranges with retry.

hazards.text: Guest aborts without randomness progress; remap returns null for invalid, RAM or exhausted cases; probe fails on duplicates; validation ends guest.
Empty, wrapped, mixed and conflicting memtype ranges fail; RAM fails busy unless default with one mode rejected and one demoted.
Top empty forced present cannot gate release; isolated flush defers cross work; double arming warns; flush needs interrupts except early boot.
Bringup defaults fix limits to 0xffff, CR0 to 0x60000010 and related control state; status bits map to SEV, SNP, virtual-top and extended labels.
Fragments depend on external logging, locking, alignment and table helpers owned outside this dossier and not specified here.

invariants.text: Intel affirms string-IO and encryption; AMD virtual-top affirms only encryption while classic uses SME mask and SEV bits; transforms invert by mode.
Remap rejects zero, wrapped and RAM ranges, aligns and reserves memtype with unwind; protection adds encryption and cache bits with promotion bans.
Empty is zero raw ignoring erratum mask; present includes protection-none and large; top empty forced present without five-level; native make wraps raw.
Reservation sanitises bounds and bypasses when disabled; RAM needs all-default then stamps; non-RAM needs uniform type and exact-match erase.
Changes filter text, rodata and BIOS, split large pages on partial or mismatch with WX warn, replicate attributes and propagate aliases with flush.
Broadcast and sync have active and inert builds; active checks alignment and forbids migration; cache flush steps with patched fenced instructions.
Validation uses monitor or direct path then evicts new private pages; exceptions need valid flag; VMSA adjusts levels; VC needs encryption.
Direct map descends or materializes tables, reuses compatible entries and propagates globals; MMIO trace gates on atomic flag with refcounted pages.

locks.text: One spinlock serialises non-RAM intervals; attribute walks lock under address-space protection; splits hold table lock.
Trace install and unmap hold IRQ-safe locks; probe register and unregister add fault lock with interrupts saved across arming.
SVSM validation and GHCB use run IRQ-disabled on per-CPU areas; guest requests borrow the block with interrupts suppressed.

state_machines.text: Vendor starts none then steers to AMD, Intel or neutral; random retries a fixed count, succeeding on carry and failing after exhaustion.
Change canonicalises masks, purges stale maps and walks merging set and clear with flush on change; collapse rebuilds when subentries agree.
Records start unarmed; arming saves presence, flushes one entry then marks armed with double-arm warn; release disarms at zero and defers free.
GHCB moves inactive, active and backup with single nesting; PSC runs to end; requests retry on busy; kexec quiesces, shuts APs and reprivatizes.

structs.text: CC flags hold host SNP bit; SEV keeps after-init scalars plus per-CPU runtime areas; GHCB info carries kind and protocol fields.
Fault record holds address, armed flag, refcount, saved presence and link; interval holds start, end and mode; trace holds phys, virt and op.
PSC entries hold frame, op and size with progress header; SVSM id encodes protocol plus call; conversion holds mapping, level and direction.
